insight: Bootstrapped and built by writers with no venture funding.
name: Novelcrafter
tagline: Plan, write and organize your novel with bring-your-own-key AI.
description: Novelcrafter is a browser-based platform for fiction and non-fiction authors that pairs a full manuscript editor with a worldbuilding wiki called the Codex for characters, places and lore. AI features — scene generation, summaries, character extraction and beat-to-scene drafting — run through your own provider key, so you choose the model and pay the API rates directly. Plans start at $4/month after a free trial.

modelSupport.notes: Connect a provider key or run local models via LM Studio/Ollama; AI usage is billed by the provider, not Novelcrafter.

edge: Combines a full manuscript editor and a worldbuilding ‘Codex’ wiki with bring-your-own-key AI, so you pick any model and pay only your provider's API rates.
pros: Full manuscript editor in the browser
cons: AI API billed separately on top
